args.topic: EIA crude oil production forecast vs actual, natural gas production

args.query: crude oil production barrels per day forecast

sql: SELECT DISTINCT eia_area_code, state_abbr, fuel_type, process_code, process_name FROM energy.eia_crude_oil_production WHERE eia_area_code ILIKE '%US%' OR state_abbr IS NULL ORDER BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT eia_area_code, state_abbr, process_code, process_name FROM energy.eia_natural_gas_production WHERE eia_area_code ILIKE '%US%' OR state_abbr IS NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT production_year, MIN(production_month) AS min_m, MAX(production_month) AS max_m, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(production_volume) AS avg_vol, production_unit
FROM energy.eia_crude_oil_production
WHERE eia_area_code = 'NUS' AND fuel_type = 'Crude Oil' AND production_unit = 'MBBL/D'
GROUP BY production_year, production_unit
ORDER BY production_year

SELECT production_year, MIN(production_month) AS min_m, MAX(production_month) AS max_m, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(production_volume) AS avg_vol, production_unit
FROM energy.eia_natural_gas_production
WHERE eia_area_code = 'NUS' AND process_code = 'VGM'
GROUP BY production_year, production_unit
ORDER BY production_year

SELECT production_year,
       SUM(production_volume) AS total_mmcf,
       SUM(production_volume) / 1000.0 AS total_bcf,
       AVG(production_volume / (1000.0 * CASE production_month
             WHEN 2 THEN 28.25 WHEN 4 THEN 30 WHEN 6 THEN 30 WHEN 9 THEN 30 WHEN 11 THEN 30 ELSE 31 END)) AS avg_bcf_per_day
FROM energy.eia_natural_gas_production
WHERE eia_area_code = 'NUS' AND process_code = 'VGM' AND production_year IN (2024,2025,2026)
GROUP BY production_year
ORDER BY production_year

SELECT production_year,
       AVG(production_volume / (1000.0 * CASE production_month
             WHEN 1 THEN 31 WHEN 2 THEN (CASE WHEN production_year % 4 = 0 THEN 29 ELSE 28 END)
             WHEN 3 THEN 31 WHEN 4 THEN 30 WHEN 5 THEN 31 WHEN 6 THEN 30
             WHEN 7 THEN 31 WHEN 8 THEN 31 WHEN 9 THEN 30 WHEN 10 THEN 31
             WHEN 11 THEN 30 WHEN 12 THEN 31 END)) AS avg_bcf_per_day
FROM energy.eia_natural_gas_production
WHERE eia_area_code = 'NUS' AND process_code = 'VGM' AND production_year IN (2024,2025,2026)
GROUP BY production_year ORDER BY production_year

sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT production_year, production_month, production_volume,
    CASE 
      WHEN production_month IN (1,3,5,7,8,10,12) THEN 31
      WHEN production_month IN (4,6,9,11) THEN 30
      WHEN production_month = 2 AND production_year % 4 = 0 THEN 29
      WHEN production_month = 2 THEN 28
    END AS dim
  FROM energy.eia_natural_gas_production
  WHERE eia_area_code = 'NUS' AND process_code = 'VGM' AND production_year IN (2024,2025,2026)
)
SELECT production_year, AVG(production_volume / (1000.0 * dim)) AS avg_bcf_per_day, COUNT(*) AS months
FROM d GROUP BY production_year ORDER BY production_year

  DATE_DIFF('day', DATE_TRUNC('month', MAKE_DATE(production_year, production_month, 1)), DATE_TRUNC('month', MAKE_DATE(production_year, production_month, 1)) + INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS dim,
  production_volume
FROM energy.eia_natural_gas_production
